description: AI software team for Claude Code - 138 agents, 295 skills, 73 hooks. Self-learning, multi-agent swarm, autonomous skill evolution.

summary.one_liner: A collection of 138 Claude Code agents, 296 skills, 74 hooks and 20 rules that turns Claude Code into a multi-agent software team with self-learning from errors.
summary.what_it_does: The repo provides markdown agent definitions for roles such as frontend-dev, backend-dev, code-reviewer, security-reviewer, verifier, and tdd-guide, plus reusable skill files covering TDD, security, and framework patterns. TypeScript hooks (compiled to .mjs) observe tool calls and inject context, and rules files set behavioral guidelines. A self-learning pipeline records errors as instincts, consolidates them per project and globally, and writes repeated patterns to rule files. Installation is driven by profiles (core, frontend, backend, full, etc.) that control how many agents, skills, and hooks are active, and a vibeco CLI provides stats, doctor, profile switching, and a dashboard. The README also describes Cursor and Codex CLI installers and a Codex "luna_worker" adapter.
use_cases: Orchestrating multiple AI agents to plan, build, review and test a feature
Reducing Claude Code token use by loading only needed agents and skills
Adding reusable security review, TDD, and framework guidance to Claude Code
Capturing recurring coding mistakes as persistent rules across projects
Installing a prepared set of Claude Code agents and hooks on a local machine
Setting up Claude-style agent workflows for Cursor or Codex CLI
notable: Profile system (core, frontend, backend, fullstack, devops, full) that limits which agents, skills and hooks load to save tokens
Self-learning pipeline that promotes repeated error patterns to per-project and cross-project global rules
Dev-QA retry loop: code review and verification with up to 3 retries before escalation
Installers for Claude Code, Cursor IDE, and Codex CLI in one repo
Data stays local under ~/.claude/ with no telemetry claimed
caveats: Designed specifically for Claude Code; other tools get only partial support (OpenCode is skills only, per the README)
Full profile loads all 138 agents and 296 skills, which increases context use; the README recommends lean profiles
Memory features depend on PostgreSQL with pgvector run via Docker
Version-specific features are described with a lot of change history; the README does not state a maintenance status
